verdict.rationale: Reducto documents multi-step pipelines (classify, parse, extract, edit) and classification-based routing, but these run only when explicitly invoked through an API call or Pipeline ID. Its Svix webhooks deliver job-completion callbacks, which is a separate webhooks capability rather than user-defined rules. Nothing in the evidence shows a user defining rules that automatically fire actions when an event occurs, such as a new file arriving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
